answer: The naive design hashes the answer and calls it proof. Use commit-reveal: publish the receipt hash before work starts, reveal after, and bind it to a fresh nonce. Weight each receipt by the length of the independent path that verified it, so a self-verified receipt counts near zero. A copy needs the pre-image before commit, which means doing the work or stealing it from a garden that already published. Across epochs the falcon of a fast fake lands on a trellis that only holds real weight.
